items.lede: This group will oversee the company's national security concerns and global trade compliance to avoid a repeat of Jensen's scandals.
items.title: Nvidia board establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee in wake of Jensen Huang scandal

items.lede: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.
items.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security

items.lede: Standing committee will oversee export compliance following allegations its GPUs were diverted to China
items.title: Nvidia places chip exports under boardroom supervision after Huang's exit
